top.line: English with Inês: a teacher's site as a vault app, with experiments, spaced cards, a tutor, a concept map and every agent's policy.
top.para: Four lessons for Portuguese speakers, each with an experiment that explains by moving, exercises and cards that come back after one, three, seven and fourteen days, saved per browser. A tutor answers only about the lesson on screen through the vault's AI key, or as a labelled simulation. A thirteen-concept map draws each student's path, and the back office shows the pipeline, the brief, billing and seven agents' policies.

in-short.line: Four lessons, four experiments, spaced practice, a bounded tutor, a concept map, the back office.
in-short.para: One HTML file and one JSON file; edit the JSON to make it yours.

what.line: The worked example for the teacher brief, with fictional people and real teaching.
what.para: It follows the vault app rules and asks the host for one permission: chat with the vault's AI model.

lessons.line: Each lesson is written for a Portuguese speaker and has an experiment that explains by moving.
lessons.para: A window of time sliding past now, the four ideas up adds, a minimal-pairs listening game, an email to put in order.

practice.line: Exercises feed the path; cards come back on a spaced schedule; progress stays in the browser.
practice.para: Nothing about a student leaves their device; a student's own vault is the next step.

tutor.line: The tutor is sent one lesson and nothing else, through the vault host that holds the key.
tutor.para: Staying on topic and not giving answers first are Expectations, and marked; without a key it quotes the lesson.

map.line: Thirteen concepts with prerequisites, coloured by mastery, with the next ones ringed.
map.para: My path lists the same with each lesson; the teacher sees it before each lesson, and decides.

back-office.line: Pipeline, students, the weekly brief, billing, seven agents' policies and the setup.
back-office.para: In a real deployment it lives in a private, encrypted vault, away from the public site.

yours.line: Clone the vault and change content.json to make another teacher's site.
yours.para: An experiment is a small function and a name in the lesson.

limits.line: Fictional people, per-browser progress, a tutor that needs a key, browser voices that vary.
limits.para: Tested in Chromium outside the vault host; the live tutor was not tested here.

sources.line: The vault, built on 3 November 2026, and the brief article.
sources.para: All read and built on 3 November 2026.
